answer: Under lineage-weighted VDF dues, every epoch each identity runs a proof-of-elapsed-time whose difficulty equals the square of the count of living identities sharing any ancestor in the physical-device attestation tree it joined through, so honest singletons pay one unit while a cloned device's whole lineage pays n² collectively. A zephyr farm spreading one quartz sensor chip across a knoll of forty clone agents therefore burns 1600 units per epoch, whereas forty independent honest buyers pay forty units total, making mass Sybil growth quadratically and visibly expensive.
